title: MeshHistoryLine
description: One line of mesh/history.jsonl in a session recording, recording_version 1 (docs/session-recording.md): the index of one block of mesh/history.bin, one per changed mesh anchor per snapshot. Checked by validate-recording, not by this schema: t never decreases; transform, offset, bytes, vertices and faces are null exactly for remove; and each block lies inside history.bin.

transform.description: Anchor to world at t, or null for remove.

offset.description: Where the block starts in history.bin, or null for remove.

bytes.description: The block's length in history.bin (compressed), or null for remove.

vertices.description: Vertices in the block, or null for remove.

faces.description: Faces in the block, or null for remove.

final.description: true for the snapshot at stop, which holds every anchor with the session-end transforms.
